name: boltai
title: BoltAI
description: Ask your AI models, run AI Workflows on selected text, start chats and paste prompts with BoltAI.
author: daniel_nguyenx

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask BoltAI
commands.subtitle: BoltAI
commands.description: Send a one-off prompt with your default model and show the answer.

commands.name: run-workflow
commands.title: Run AI Workflow
commands.subtitle: BoltAI
commands.description: Run an AI Workflow or Multi-step Workflow on the selected text, the clipboard or typed input.

commands.name: new-chat
commands.title: New Chat
commands.subtitle: BoltAI
commands.description: Start a new chat in BoltAI, optionally sending a first message.

commands.name: search-prompts
commands.title: Search Prompts
commands.subtitle: BoltAI
commands.description: Find a saved prompt and paste or copy its text.

preferences.name: boltPath
preferences.title: bolt Path
preferences.description: Path to the bolt command-line tool. Leave empty to find it in ~/.local/bin, /Applications/BoltAI.app or the Setapp app.
